name: inkspira
description: Plan a tattoo: list supported styles, placements and colours, build a prefilled generator link, and return actual-size printable samples and a photo placement preview.

npm.description: Run locally over stdio with npx

http.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint, no authentication

examples.title: Check supported options
examples.description: Lists the style, placement and colour values the generator accepts.
examples.prompt: Which tattoo styles and placements does Inkspira support?

examples.title: Prepare a preview link
examples.description: Builds a generator URL from a non-identifying motif.
examples.prompt: Make me an Inkspira preview link for a fine-line fern on the forearm in black and grey.

examples.title: Find printable sizes
examples.description: Returns the actual-size A4 samples and the photo placement preview.
examples.prompt: Where can I compare 3 cm and 5 cm tattoos at actual size?

tools.name: list_tattoo_options
tools.description: Return the style, placement and color identifiers accepted by the Inkspira generator.

tools.name: create_tattoo_preview_link
tools.description: Build a prefilled Inkspira generator link from a non-identifying tattoo motif. Image generation happens only after the user signs in and chooses to generate.

prompt.description: Tattoo motif and composition without identifying details (max 300 characters).

style.description: One of the styles returned by list_tattoo_options.

placement.description: One of the placements returned by list_tattoo_options.

color.description: sw for black and grey, farbig for colour.

tools.name: list_tattoo_planning_resources
tools.description: Return the public Inkspira links for actual-size printable examples and the photo placement preview.
